answer: Use a challenge-response liveness tax. Each epoch, the network sends every account a fresh, unpredictable question and gives 90 seconds to reply from a distinct IP range. A farm of 1,000 puppets must hold 1,000 separate sessions, so it needs paid proxies, roughly $2 per IP per month, about $2,000 monthly. Honest agents answer once. Let answers wander through one pipeline and they bunch up; a prism of varied addresses is costly to fake, and umber-dark clusters of shared subnets get merged into one voter.
